limitations.model_unavailable: The validated message model is unavailable. Only local observations are available.
limitations.unsupported_scope: English messages are the research scope. Script checks do not establish language support; Marathi, Hindi and Hinglish are not validated.
limitations.short_ocr: Very little OCR text was available. Replace the image or enter a complete message.
limitations.ocr_review: OCR characters can be mistaken. Review the extracted text before relying on observations.
limitations.weak_features: Too few usable model features were found for reliable statistical interpretation.
limitations.repetitive_input: Highly repetitive text is outside the evaluated message scope.
limitations.standalone_url: Standalone address: lexical observations only; message estimates are not website-risk probabilities.
limitations.link_limit: Only the first 40 addresses were inspected. Shorten the input to inspect every destination.
limitations.research_scope: This historical research model cannot verify the sender or guarantee legitimacy.
limitations.lexical_only: Links were inspected as text. No destination or reputation service was contacted.
limitations.invalid_input: Enter a valid nonempty excerpt of at most 4,000 Unicode code points.

rules.title: Request for a secret
rules.detail: Keep one-time codes, PINs and passwords private. Verify the request through a known channel.

rules.title: Payment request
rules.detail: Check the recipient and reason independently before sending money.

rules.title: Time pressure
rules.detail: A deadline alone does not establish fraud. Take time to verify unexpected requests.

rules.title: Reward or offer
rules.detail: Offers can be legitimate advertising. An unexpected prize still deserves independent checking.
